posts.author: Nephis
posts.body:
Hi everyone!
I'm working on a project in
RPG Maker MV
and I’m looking for a specific character: a
Female Orc Barbarian
.
Ideally, I’m looking for a walking sprite (charset) and a matching FaceSet. The character should have green or grayish skin, and be wearing "savage" or barbarian-style clothing (furs, leather, or torn fabrics).
Since I’m also trying to learn how to customize my own resources, I would love some advice on the following:
Templates/Bases:
Does anyone know where I can find Orc or Half-Orc templates compatible with MV's proportions?
Generator Parts:
Are there any specific add-ons for the built-in Character Generator (like tusks, pointed ears, or barbarian outfits) that you would recommend?
Tutorials:
If I wanted to edit an existing human sprite to make it look like an orc, what is the best way to change the skin tone while keeping the original shading and highlights?
If you know of any existing free-to-use resources or even paid DLCs that fit this description, please let me know!
Thank you so much for your time and help!
